title: Graph Attention-based Decentralized Actor-Critic for Dual-Objective Control of Multi-UAV Networks
abstract: arXiv:2506.09195v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This research focuses on optimizing multi-UAV systems with dual objectives: maximizing service coverage as the primary goal while extending battery lifetime as the secondary objective. We propose a Graph Attention-based Decentralized Actor-Critic (GADC) to optimize the dual objectives. The proposed approach leverages a graph attention network to process UAVs' limited local observation and reduce the dimension of the environment states. Subsequently, an actor-double-critic network is developed to manage dual policies for joint objective optimization. The proposed GADC uses a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence factor to balance the tradeoff between coverage performance and battery lifetime in the multi-UAV system. We assess the scalability and efficiency of GADC through comprehensive benchmarking against state-of-the-art methods, considering both theory and experimental aspects. translated_title: 基于图注意力的去中心化Actor-Critic方法用于多无人机网络的双目标控制
translated_abstract: 本研究聚焦于多无人机系统的优化问题，该系统具有双重目标：以最大化服务覆盖为主要目标，同时以延长电池寿命为次要目标。我们提出了一种基于图注意力的去中心化Actor-Critic方法（GADC）来优化这两个目标。该方法利用图注意力网络处理无人机有限的局部观测，并降低环境状态的维度。随后，开发了一种actor-双critic网络来管理双重策略，实现联合目标优化。所提出的GADC使用Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度因子来平衡多无人机系统中覆盖性能与电池寿命之间的权衡。我们从理论和实验两方面，通过与时下最先进方法的全面基准对比，评估了GADC的可扩展性和效率。在理想环境和NVIDIA S（原文摘要在此处截断）中进行了广泛测试。
tldr: 提出一种基于图注意力网络的去中心化Actor-Critic方法GADC，通过actor-双critic结构和KL散度因子，联合优化多无人机网络的服务覆盖与电池寿命双目标。
en_tdlr: Proposes GADC, a graph attention-based decentralized actor-critic method that jointly optimizes service coverage and battery lifetime in multi-UAV networks using an actor-double-critic architecture and a KL divergence balancing factor.
